key_finding.title: 981 seconds
key_finding.text: In Saffire VI, smoke was readily detected at 981 seconds, after most of the hazardous gas release had already happened.

gaps.text: There is currently no partial-gravity combustion data in PSI. Microgravity and normal-gravity results could bound what happens at intermediate gravity levels.

control_need.text: Detection came after most of the hazardous gas release, which suggests a need to detect gases earlier than smoke alone.
